title: Security review: API-created deployments, shared sign-in, custom domains and bring-your-own Google client
description: Review before build reaches production. Questions: (1) who may create, change and delete a deployment (Papyrus control plane role, operators, self-serve sign-up) and the abuse limits; (2) binding a shared-client token to one deployment so a token for tenant A cannot act on tenant B (audience or host binding checked centrally in authorize); (3) custom domain ownership proof (DNS TXT), uniqueness across tenants and takeover after deletion; (4) storage, access and rotation of bring-your-own Google client secrets (SSM SecureString per deployment, who can set and read); (5) replacing the per-site role list in the API Gateway resource policy with one shared-tier Papyrus role; (6) Cyclotron lab verifier trust moving from the site registry to deployment records; (7) public-reader site subjects per deployment rather than per product; (8) deletion and export under billing standing; (9) every new IAM permission and parameter, for Ryan's approval.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Ryan, 2026-11-09: the design partner's three new sites launch directly on the shared tier at Papyrus M7, never as dedicated sites. This is required for the partner launch at M7, not a later migration. Priority raised to 1.
